column2: TITLE THEME (main menu, loops). Orchestral NOIR JAZZ ballad, rainy city at night, cinematic like L.A. Noire. 70 bpm, 4/4, swing 0.15, D minor, 16 bars (A 8 + A' 8). Lead: muted trumpet (59) states the leitmotif bars 1–4, tenor sax (66) answers bars 5–8, both together in thirds on A'. Rootless piano voicings (0) on 2 and 4 with occasional fills, acoustic upright bass (32) walking in A', two-feel in A. Brush kit (kit 40): brushed snare swishes as patterns, ride 51 soft, kick feathered. String ensemble (49) warm pads swelling with CC11 under A', violins high counter-line in the last 4 bars. Vibraphone (11) sparse colour notes. End bar on A7(b9) back to Dm.

ZONE 1 (early stage) exploration loop. Fantasy, mysterious and wondrous, NO jazz/mafia. 88 bpm, 4/4, straight, D dorian, 24 bars (intro 4 + A 8 + B 8 + transition 4). Harp (46) flowing 8th arpeggios (patterns), string ensemble divisi pads (48 violins high, 48 violas mid, 42 cellos) with CC11 swells, flute (73) lead with the leitmotif in augmentation, oboe (68) answering in B, French horn (60) warm counter-melody in B, celesta-like Tinkle Bell (112) or crystal sparkle sparse, contrabass (43) roots. Light orchestral percussion only in B (kit 48: soft timpani-like tom 41 on bar downbeats, suspended cymbal swell 49 low velocity). Calm, beautiful, not busy.

ZONE 2 (mid stage, deep catacombs) exploration loop. Fantasy, TENSE and dark, NO jazz. 100 bpm, 4/4, E phrygian dominant (transpose the leitmotif to E), 24 bars. Low strings ostinato: cellos (42) + contrabass (43) 8th-note spiccato-like short notes (dur 0.35) in patterns with accents; pizzicato strings (45) offbeats; tremolo strings (44) high sustained clusters with CC11 swells; choir (52) dark pad on vowel; bassoon (70) and clarinet (71) low melodic fragments of the leitmotif; taiko (116) pulse on beat 1 and the "and" of 3 (patterns), orchestral kit 48 timpani-like toms on phrase ends; French horns (60) stopped-style ominous long notes in the last 8 bars. Builds tension, then subsides into the loop.

MINIBOSS BATTLE loop. EPIC orchestral + choir, 140 bpm, 4/4, D harmonic minor, 32 bars (A 8 + B 8 + A' 8 + C 8). Driving string ostinato (48 + 49 + 44) in 16ths (patterns), cellos/contrabass (42/43) heavy octave 8ths, brass section (61) + trombones (57) powerful stabs and the leitmotif in full brass at A', French horns (60) heroic counter-line in B, trumpets (56) fanfare figures in C, choir (52) epic sustained chords fortissimo in A' and C, taiko (116) + kit 48 (concert bass drum 36, concert snare 38 rolls via fast notes, cymbal crashes 49/57 at section starts), timpani (47) on downbeats with fills at phrase ends. Relentless but musical; C builds to the loop restart.

DEATH STING (like a souls-like "YOU DIED" moment), NOT a loop ("loop": false). 60 bpm, 3 bars (≈ 12 s with ringing). Bar 1: a deep impact — timpani (47) D2 ff + contrabass/cellos D1/D2 sforzando + low brass (58 tuba, 57 trombones) D minor chord; choir (52) enters pp and swells (CC11) on a dark D minor (add9) chord with the leitmotif's last notes F4→E4→D4 in the altos; bar 2–3: strings (49) sustain and decay, a single harp (46) low D harmonic at the end. Sombre, majestic, final.

TITLE STING (plays when the player presses the first key), NOT a loop. 90 bpm, 2 bars (≈ 4 s with ringing). Noir orchestral hit: beat 1 a full Dm(add9) chord — piano (0) low octaves ff, upright bass (32) D1, string ensemble (48) sforzando then CC11 decay, brass section (61) short stab, crash cymbal (49) + kick (36) in kit 0; then a muted trumpet (59) rising leitmotif figure A4 D5 F5 A5 landing on A5 held with vibraphone (11) doubling; strings sustain under it and fade by CC11.

BOSS DEFEATED FANFARE, NOT a loop. 100 bpm, 3 bars (≈ 6 s incl. ringing). D MAJOR Picardy transformation of the leitmotif (D5 F#5 A5 … D6) in trumpets (56) + French horns (60) harmonised, brass section (61) full chords, strings (48) rising scale into a sustained D major chord, choir (52) on the final chord, timpani (47) roll (fast repeated D2/A2 notes crescendo) into a cymbal crash (kit 48, 49) on bar 3 beat 1. Triumphant, short, glorious.
